description: Implementation of a task watchdog timer for Zephyr RTOS, managing multiple watchdog channels, including hardware fallback, with functions for initialization, adding, deleting, and feeding channels.

classes.name: task_wdt_channel
classes.description: Data structure representing a task watchdog channel, including reload period, absolute timeout ticks, user data, and callback function.

methods.name: schedule_next_timeout
methods.description: Schedules the next timeout for the task watchdog channels based on their absolute timeout ticks.

methods.name: task_wdt_trigger
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the watchdog timer expires, either scheduling the next timeout or executing the callback or reboot.

methods.name: task_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the task watchdog, optionally setting up hardware fallback, and starts the internal timer.

methods.name: task_wdt_add
methods.description: Adds a new watchdog channel with specified reload period, callback, and user data.

methods.name: task_wdt_feed
methods.description: Feeds (resets) the specified watchdog channel to prevent timeout.
